create_camera_image: create a simulated camera image using a pybullet client with position, orientation, resolution, and projection matrix
convert_intrinsics_to_projection_matrix: convert camera intrinsics to an OpenGL projection matrix given width, height, and clipping plane distances
convert_opengl_depth_to_distance: convert an OpenGL depth value to a real-world distance in meters using near and far clipping planes
render_mounted_camera_image: render an RGB, depth, RGBD, or point cloud image from a camera mounted on a robot body link
transform_point_cloud_to_world_frame: transform a point cloud from the camera frame to the world frame using pybullet transform multiplication
